Current Branch accepts filtered-out live branch, detached, unborn and bare HEAD, closes once, blocks duplicate/refresh/accept/cancel/ordinary close and owned child. Immediate forced controller close cancels query and fences late callback. Actual owned remote-only tracking child accepts local Current Branch but parent releases without config mutation/error. Existing native tracking receiver passes both engines including normal remote set/unset and error gates.
